'''Feral Endermen''' are the [[Feral Parasites|Feral Version]] of [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Enderman Endermen]. Killing them will grant the {{AdvancementLink|Fermented Arrogance}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawned when an Enderman is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
* Spawns from an Enderman succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Enderman]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 9 Endermen have been assimilated and the End has reached [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Feral Endermen are Melee Combatants/Aggressive Support units. They use hit and run tactics teleporting in and out of close combat. 

*Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Assimilated Enderman can perform the following abilities:
**Teleport themselves as well as nearby [[Rupter|Rupters]], [[:Category:Walking Heads|Walking Heads]], [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]], [[:Category:Feral Parasites|Feral Parasites]], and [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive Parasites]]. Their teleportation Ability is based on the following logic:
***Upon sight of a target, the teleportation noise will play.
*** Feral Endermen cannot teleport within the first 1.5 seconds of finding a target.
*** After it manages to teleport, it will teleport a nearby Rupter, Assimilated Mob, Feral Parasite, or Primitive Parasite.
*** 0.5 damage will be inflicted to the teleported mob (unless it is an [[Assimilated Enderman]], a [[Walking Enderman Head]], or another Feral Enderman)
*** The ability to teleport other Parasites has a cooldown of 0.5 seconds. This cooldown is removed if the Feral Enderman takes damage or has the [[Rage]] effect.
*** If the Feral Enderman is on fire, there is a 75% chance the mob it teleports will also catch fire.

*Feral Endermen are immune to ranged attacks, teleporting away from Projectiles, similar to their Sane counterpart.
*Similar to their assimilated version, it doesn't present any weakness in being in contact with Water.
**Feral Endermen can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
**Feral Endermen are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.

* On hit Feral Endermen has a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].

=== ''Weaknesses''===
*Feral Endermen, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death Feral Endermen have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Feral Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* On death Feral Endermen have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]].
